notes: EDGE CASE: borderline ACTIVE vs OFF_MARKET_SALE. The email says the listing is 'quietly on the market' which SOUNDS off-market, but the operative facts - it IS on the RLS/public, has an open house, and a live public price - make it a genuine ACTIVE_SALE_LISTING that the agent is simply not heavily advertising. True category is ACTIVE_SALE_LISTING. Lower confidence floor for the deliberate ambiguity.

input.subject: Quietly on the market - Murray Hill 2BR, $1.15M
input.bodyText:
Hi all,

We're keeping this one low-key - it's quietly on the market, no big push - but to be clear it IS listed on the RLS and public as of Monday, so co-brokes are fully welcome and there's a price out there.

150 E 37th St, Unit 8G, Murray Hill
2BR / 2BA co-op, ~1,050 sf, prewar full-service building, live-in super
Asking $1,150,000 | Maintenance $1,640/mo (heat + hot water included)
Board approval, 20% down min

Already live and showable now - open house this Sunday 1-3. Co-broke 2.5%. Send your buyers.

Hannah Liu
Compass
